counterfactual_missing_items: No evidence of anti-dsDNA or anti-Sm antibodies to support SLE
No acute systemic sclerosis flare features beyond background history
No alternative infectious or embolic cause confirmed
decisive_items: diffuse stenosis and a beaded pattern of the anterior and middle cerebral arteries and their branches
response.rationale: R2 is directly supported by the angiographic findings of diffuse stenosis and beading consistent with cerebral angiitis, which is the acute presentation. R4 represents the underlying chronic condition but does not explain the acute neurological deterioration. R5 is weakly supported by ANA positivity but contradicted by negative specific antibodies and lacks typical SLE features.

rejected.why: Only ANA positivity is cited, but anti-centromere and anti-Scl-70 are negative, and no SLE-specific antibodies or clinical criteria are met; the nucleolar pattern is more typical of SSc.
